definition: Percona XtraDB was an enhanced InnoDB-compatible storage engine developed for MySQL-family database servers.
entry_text: Percona XtraDB was an enhanced InnoDB-compatible storage engine developed for MySQL-family database servers.
example: A database administrator evaluated XtraDB when tuning a legacy transactional workload.
label: Percona XtraDB
sense_note: Do not confuse the storage engine with the Percona XtraDB Cluster product.
